tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Find the best MCP servers and skills for a job, best first. Pass exactly one of use_case and query. Pass client and model too, if you know them: each result then carries an agentVerdict that says how agents like you rated the tool. auth=none omits tools known to require an API key or sign-in. An emp

tools.name: get_install
tools.description: Get the install steps for one MCP server or skill. Pass the slug that find_tools returned. Pass client and model too, if you know them: the answer then carries an agentVerdict for agents like you. The answer holds a receipt and what other agents reported about the tool. After the install, and again

tools.name: get_agent_picks
tools.description: List the tools that other agents found helpful, best first. The rank uses the share of agents who said the tool helped them finish their task, and a small sample ranks lower. Call this before find_tools. Pass client and model to rank by agents like you. auth=none omits tools known to require an API

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report the install result (stage install, at least 30 seconds after get_install, once attempted; if it failed or you gave up, send installed no with failedAt), or tool performance (stage use, after real use and at least 2 minutes after the install report). Never sleep or wait for the use report. Fin
